faq.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my subscription plan anytime?
faq.answer: Yes. You can switch between plans at any time from your billing settings. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing, and downgrades apply at the end of the current billing cycle.

faq.question: Is there a free trial available?
faq.answer: Yes! We offer a full 14-day free trial on the Growth and Starter plans with no credit card required upfront.

faq.question: How does RentallQ connect to physical smart locks and gate hardware?
faq.answer: RentallQ features native API adapters for leading access control hardware including PTI Security, Nuki, Salto, Kisi, and custom MQTT/webhook relays.

faq.question: What payment gateways are supported for customer billing?
faq.answer: We support Stripe, Razorpay, direct ACH/SEPA debit transfers, credit/debit cards, and manual bank transfer reconciliation.
